candidateJoin.canonicalCoordinates: [theta_i,n_j]=i delta_ij; theta_i are compact cosine coordinates
candidateJoin.physicalMeaning: a capacitance matrix proportional to G produces the charging metric G^-1; local junction or rotor locking supplies the diagonal cosines

separabilityAudit.criterion: the Wave 7.160 product spectrum transports only when the charging matrix is diagonal in the same integral compact coordinates as the cosine arguments
separabilityAudit.obstruction: orthogonal whitening diagonalizes the quadratic kinetic term over the reals but turns the compact local cosines into coupled nonintegral vertex operators in general

comparisonWithIndependentSurrogate.interpretation: the independent-channel nonlinear gap is not the gap of the joined metric-plus-cosine carrier; even its small-oscillation scale begins about 4.14 times lower

measurementGate.prerequisite: pass the Wave 7.177 linear 24-port matrix and held-out-drive packet
measurementGate.driveRegime: add the local cosine elements, cool below the soft-mode scale and sweep weak spectroscopy through all 24 linearized normal modes
measurementGate.predictedLinearizedInvariant: after one fitted overall energy scale, the 24 frozen scale-free resonance ratios equal sqrt(lambda_max(G)/lambda_a(G)) up to the declared loss and matrix-error budgets
measurementGate.nonlinearContinuation: use weak-drive and two-tone spectroscopy while sweeping a calibrated tunable U/u ratio; extract anharmonic 0-to-1 and 1-to-2 transitions and compare to a finite-cutoff diagonalization of the same measured G and fitted U,u
measurementGate.rejection: reject this carrier if the resonance ratios fail the measured-matrix prediction, if one U,u model cannot predict held-out modes and tunable-ratio settings, or if the finite-cutoff gap is not stable

established: the physical quadratic metric and diagonal rotor locking define a coupled 24-dimensional compact Hamiltonian with a certified harmonic spectrum; the previously quoted product-pendulum gap does not transport to it
boundary: No exact nonlinear 24-channel gap, thermodynamic bulk gap, chiral edge, orbifold sector or Monster operator product is established here. The harmonic frequencies are a small-oscillation prediction, not a rigorous lower bound on the nonlinear gap.
epistemicStatus: theorem for the harmonic reduction and nonseparability; experimental protocol for the nonlinear continuation; Monster identification remains conditional on later gates
